executive_summary: Narration still creates the consequential proposition, and sentence-level alias overlap can stamp that whole sentence as authored world truth. The GM Resolution Decision already claims this ownership and does not exercise it before prose. Decision A: salvage by making that decision own the complete consequential claim set before narration.
